nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.xnat_inputs
=======================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.xnat_inputs

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   XNAT input mode for PESA-Fat (IA_PET_V5).

   This module downloads the required DICOM resources from XNAT into the existing
   PESA-Fat DICOM layout so the rest of the pipeline (stage0_convert → stages 1-3)
   can run unchanged.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.xnat_inputs.XnatPesaFatRequest

Module Contents

.. py:class:: XnatPesaFatRequest

   Parameters for downloading one PESA-Fat session's DICOM scans from XNAT.


   .. py:attribute:: project_id
      :type:  str
      :value: 'IA_PET_V5'



   .. py:attribute:: session_label

      :type:  bool
      :value: True



.. py:function:: batch_from_session_date(value: Any) -> str

   Convert an XNAT experiment date into PESA-Fat batch name: YYYYMM_Week1..Week4.


.. py:function:: download_pesa_fat_dicoms_from_xnat(*, batch: str | None, subjects: Iterable[str], dicom_root: pathlib.Path, xnat_config_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, request: XnatPesaFatRequest | None = None) -> dict[str, tuple[str, dict[str, pathlib.Path]]]

   Download DICOMs from XNAT into ``dicom_root/<batch>/<subject>/<sequence>/``.

   If *batch* is None or "auto", the batch is derived per subject from the XNAT experiment date.

   Returns ``{subject: (batch, {sequence: local_dir})}``.
